evals.name: ycode-intake-and-recon
evals.prompt: quero tirar o site https://www.estudio-exemplo.com.br do Ycode e passar pra Next.js igualzinho, sem mudar nada. comeca pelo reconhecimento, ainda nao tenho o backup
evals.expected_output: Detects Ycode with evidence, asks the intake questions in ONE message (scope, languages, git, polish layer, review password) with defaults, then after answers copies tools to tools/migrate, writes migrate.config.json with platform ycode, runs snapshot + assets + intent-check --target live, creates docs/layout-loop.md board and sends one reconnaissance question list.

evals.name: webflow-cms-and-visual
evals.prompt: My client's marketing site is on Webflow (Business plan) with a blog collection and a case studies collection. I have a read-only API token in .env.local as WEBFLOW_API_TOKEN. Plan the migration to Next.js so it looks identical, and tell me how the CMS part will work.
evals.expected_output: Loads migrate + migrate-webflow; keeps webflow.css verbatim (no Tailwind rewrite); explains IX2 options; visual first with JSON mocks; content stage via webflow-cms-export.mjs using the env token without printing it; normalized content format; dev database only; review page at the end.

evals.name: wordpress-acf-jetengine-content
evals.prompt: Tenho um WordPress com Elementor, ACF e JetEngine (CPT de imoveis com meta boxes e relacao com corretores). Copiei a pasta do wordpress e um dump .sql pra dentro de legacy/. Como eu puxo esse conteudo pro site novo em Next?
evals.expected_output: Loads migrate-wordpress + migrate-content; never prints wp-config credentials; runs wp-inventory on folder + sql; identifies ACF groups, JetEngine post types, meta boxes and relations; exports chosen types with wp-export to content/*.json; validates; maps to the target CMS with idempotent upserts on a dev database after confirmation; plans 301 redirects.
